This suggests that investors are willing to pay a premium for the company due to its superior performance. Additionally, the company is expected to see further sales growth of +10% YoY and profit growth >20% YoY in the future (evidence [E63] and [E65]). However, this is balanced by the company's superior profitability and growth prospects, which justify the higher valuations.
